source.name: Netflix Movies and TV Shows dataset by Shivam Bansal
source.publisher: Kaggle dataset author; Zenodo preservation snapshot

checks: no duplicate title and type rows
same-year share among US additions rounds to 72.2% in 2015 and 28.1% in 2021
same-year TV share among US additions rounds to 40.0% in 2015 and 61.1% in 2021

Published genre comparison uses explicit listed_in tags: drama or international group is 4/108 (3.7%) in 2015–2017 and 240/584 (41.1%) in 2018–2021; children and family group is 10/61 (16.4%) and 129/269 (48.0%)
The explicit genre groups can overlap; clustering is not used to define the published comparison
UK release-vintage metadata check compares 11 of 86 titles in the 2020s with 29 of 463 in the 2010s; country is present because it defines the UK subset
2020s-minus-2010s difference is 6.5 percentage points; approximate 95% Newcombe interval is -1.6 to 17.1 points

evidenceBoundary: Catalog metadata and acquisition timing are not viewing, retention, title quality, licensing intent, or financial performance. The published genre comparisons use explicit, potentially overlapping tags. The UK metadata check measures director and cast because country data defines the UK subset.
